evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked; rep went straight into verifying home/logistics details after getting name/email.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concern was raised during discovery (only logistics Q&A); customer's later cost-control worry ('I don't want them to drag it out for five hours') surfaced in Stage 3 pricing, not Stage 1 - N/A/full-credit rule applied.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'It does not necessarily mean that you need to pay for a five hours... that would still really depends on how well prepared'; 'it will always be prorated to fifteen minute increments.'

top_strength: Patient, reassuring handling of an anxious elderly customer worried about cost overruns, with clear proration explanation.
coaching_note: Never asks the agenda question ('other than price, what are your concerns') - add it before diving into logistics so real concerns surface early instead of only reactively during pricing.
